title: Private Customizable Banff Tour Lake Louise-Moraine 6 More Sights
includes: Moraine Lake Access in Shared Shuttle. Max 12 pax in 15 passenger Van due to Parks Canada guidline.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Tour duration is travel time included
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This exclusive experience combines iconic sights with the flexibility to create an itinerary that suits adventurers of all ages. Uncover the breathtaking beauty of the Canadian Rockies with our Private Banff, Lake Louise & Icefields Tour, tailored to your group’s unique preferences. 

SUV bookings (under 6 pax) will share a 15-passenger shuttle with another group for the Moraine Lake portion due to park regulations. To have a 100% private vehicle for the entire day, please book our Van Tour.

Travel in comfort aboard a SUV or van, with a dedicated guide.
